reviewer_comment: Row drawn after the CR0040 and CR0127 corrections changed the sample strata (four relations of the first draw, CR0003, CR0037, CR0056 and CR0127, left the sample; their verdicts are in verification_results.md). R050 (Wikipedia 2nd Canadian Armoured Brigade): 'selected to be part of the D-Day invasion force in support of the units of the 3rd Canadian Infantry Division'; 'landed in Normandy on D-Day, 6 June 1944'; 'paired with any infantry who needed armour support'. R456 (Veterans Affairs Canada): the 3rd Canadian Infantry Division 'along with the 2nd Canadian Armoured Brigade' designated for the assault. Parent, attached type and the 6 June start match; the end is open and flagged end_unknown, which fits.
R139: 'counter-attacked by six Panthers of the 2nd Panzer Division' (09:30); R140: 'One battlegroup based around a tank battalion'. Organic link and start match.

R448: both divisions 'were in OKW reserve' on 6 June until Hitler's 1600 release; plan to place them under I SS Panzer Corps. The row covers 7 June only, a day after the documented status. Corrected after this check (V-008, see verification_results.md): the start is now 6 June, with the end still inferred from the next claim; the verdict is for the row as it was drawn (an interval of 7 June only).
R449/R448/R141 support I SS Panzer Corps from 8 June. The 12 June end is only the day before C0092 (unknown parent); no cited source dates a change (CR0042 gap).
R137: 50th Division 'reinforced with 56th Infantry Brigade, 8th Armoured Brigade'; R512: 'Formations attached for assault phase'. Attached from 6 June, end unknown, as stated.

Row drawn after the CR0040 and CR0127 corrections changed the sample strata. An explicit placeholder: the row asserts no parent, only a gap, and C0107 says 'parent not verified'. R008 (Wikipedia list of Allied forces in Normandy) has the 15th (Scottish) Infantry Division arriving 14 June (landing beach uncertain), matching the start; the 25 June end is the day before the next claim (CR0072, VIII Corps from 26 June, R140 Epsom order of battle). Correct as a gap.

Row drawn after the CR0088 correction (the earlier R08, CR0088, was corrected; see verification_results.md). Army Attached 'First' and the 13 Feb end are in the CMH 82d Airborne table (R365, named in the claim's notes): First is attached from the 17 Dec 44 row and absent from the 14 Feb 45 row. The cited R386 p. 342 and R465 do not state the attachment. Start 18 Dec is one day after the table row (claim-date convention). Part supported; start differs by a day. Row corrected afterwards (V-013, batch (b), 26 October 2026): the start is now 17 December 1944, the table row, so the start point no longer differs; the verdict stays partly supported because the cited R386 and R465 still do not state the attachment.
R453: orders 'as of 0001B hours, 15 September. At the same time tactical control was transferred from AFHQ to SHAEF'; R410 agrees. Start, order date and type match.
R445: 12th Army Group active 1 Aug, 'the 21 Army Group commander retained over-all control until 1 September'. Coordinating, 1-31 Aug matches.
R360 table '25 Jul 44 VIII First Br 21st' ... '5 Sep 44 - Ninth 12th'. Corps VIII from 25 Jul to 4 Sep matches; end basis could be assignment_table.
R341 table '10 Oct 44 (-) Third 12th' shows Third from 10 Oct; the row starts 23 Oct (the row in force at the first claim). Parent, type and open end match.
R341 table '16 Dec 44 XX Third First 12th' ... '21 Dec 44 XII Third (-) 12th'. End 20 Dec matches; start 17 Dec is a day after the 16 Dec row.
R388 p. 423-425: 'The reorganization placed the U.S. First and Ninth Armies under Montgomery's 21 Army Group'; table '20 Dec 44 ... Br 21st', dropped 18 Jan 45. All match.

Row drawn after the CR0040 and CR0127 corrections changed the sample strata. Alternate-status row for VIII Corps to Ninth Army from 5 September. R369 (8th Infantry Division table): '5 Sep 44 VIII Ninth (-) 12th'; R366 (83rd Infantry Division table): '5 Sep 44 VIII Ninth ... 12th'. The preferred reading is the Green Book's 10 September transfer, which the note records; the row's type (the tables do not say assigned or attached) and open end match.

Row drawn after the CR0040 and CR0127 corrections changed the sample strata. R421 (Riviera to the Rhine ch. 14, p. 253): 'Eisenhower, on 26 September, decided to transfer the XV Corps to the 6th Army Group on the 29th' and 'On 29 September 1944, control of the XV Corps officially passed to the 6th Army Group and the Seventh Army'. Parent, assigned type, 29 September start (narrative) and ordered date 26 September match; the end is open.
R052: '14 April 1944: V Corps ... 17 August 1944: XIX Corps'. The 4 Aug end only reflects a switch of wording (CR0209 keeps V Corps to 17 Aug), not a source.
R137: 'Utah Beach: VII Corps 4th Infantry Division'; R446. The 25 Jul end only reflects a switch of wording (CR0220 keeps VII Corps to 21 Aug), not a source.
R346 table '5 Sep 44 VIII Ninth (-) 12th' ... '21 Sep 44 XIX First 12th'. Ninth Army 5-20 Sep matches.
R355 table 'Seventh (Adm)' in the Army-attached column matches the type. It is already in the 1 Jul row and is dropped on 15 Sep (CR0295 starts then); the row runs 13 Jul to 19 Sep.
R340 table '29 Nov 44 VIII First (-) 12th', First kept to 6 Feb 45. Start and open end match.
